verdict.rationale: CrewAI's enterprise tier (AMP) explicitly advertises 'Webhook Streaming: Stream real-time events and updates to your systems' alongside a REST API for kickoff/status/resume, indicating a webhook subscription mechanism exists. However, this is gated behind the paid CrewAI AMP/Enterprise product rather than the open-source core, and no detail is given on event types, subscription setup, or payload schema. Missing for 10: documentation of specific webhook event types/payloads, open-source (non-enterprise) support, and independent/hands-on confirmation the webhook feature works as described.
